test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are of different heights. A is shorter than only two people. D is taller than only B. F is taller than A but shorter than G. C is taller than E. How many people are shorter than E?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) A is shorter than only two people.

_ > _ > A > _ > _ > _ > _

2) D is taller than only B.

_ > _ > A > _ > _ > D > B

3) F is taller than A but shorter than G.
